app.name: WiiTube
app.long_description:
Search and watch YouTube directly on the Wii, with no PC or proxy server.
Point with the Wii Remote or use the D-Pad. A selects, B goes back, + opens search, 1 changes quality (144p to 480p), HOME exits. While playing: A pauses, +/- change the volume, B returns to the videos.
A log is written to sd:/apps/wiitube/wiitube.log.
